     1→import pptxgen from 'pptxgenjs';
     2→import { saveAs } from 'file-saver';

     8→// Photo dimensions in inches
     9→const SLIDE_MARGIN = 0.15;  // Reduced lateral margin
    10→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W = 4.4;
    11→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H = 3.6;
    12→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W = 3.1;
    13→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H = 3.6;
    14→// When one slot is dual (side-by-side), it gets extra width
    15→const DUAL_SLOT_W = 5.6;  // wider slot for dual photo container
    16→const DUAL_PHOTO_H = 3.6;
    17→
    18→// Sanitize text for use in filenames
    19→function sanitizeForFilename(text: string): string {
    20→  return text
    21→    .trim()
    22→    .substring(0, 60)
    23→    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]/g, '')
    24→    .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    25→    .replace(/_+/g, '_')
    26→    .replace(/^_|_$/g, '')
    27→    || 'Inspecao';
    28→}
    29→
    30→// Helper function to generate a black image with white text
    31→function generateSerialNumberImage(serialNumber: string): string {
    32→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    33→  const width = 400;
    34→  const height = 400;
    35→  canvas.width = width;
    36→  canvas.height = height;
    37→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    38→  
    39→  if (ctx) {
    40→    // Black background
    41→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    42→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    43→    
    44→    // White text
    45→    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    46→    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    47→    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    48→    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    49→    
    50→    // Draw serial number
    51→    const displayText = serialNumber || 'N/A';
    52→    ctx.fillText(displayText, width / 2, height / 2);
    53→  }
    54→  
    55→  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    56→}

    59→const LOGO_BASE64 = 'data:image/png;base64,';

    88→
    89→export async function generatePowerPoint(options: PowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
    90→  const { inspection, photos, additionalParts, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
    91→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
    92→  
    93→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
    94→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
    95→  const finalPhotos = translatedData?.photos || photos;
    96→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
    97→  
    98→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
    99→  
   100→  // Set presentation properties
   101→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
   102→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
   103→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
   104→  
   105→  // Generate slides
   106→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   107→  
   108→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   109→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   110→  
   111→  await generatePhotoSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, language);
   112→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, additionalParts, language);
   113→  
   114→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   115→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   116→  }
   117→  
   118→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   119→  
   120→  // Save the file
   121→  const fileName = `Relatorio_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   122→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   123→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   124→}

   129→export async function generateHomePowerPoint(options: HomePowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
   130→  const { inspection, categories, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
   131→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   132→  
   133→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
   134→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
   135→  const finalCategories = translatedData?.categories || categories;
   136→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
   137→  
   138→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
   139→  
   140→  // Set presentation properties
   141→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
   142→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
   143→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
   144→  
   145→  // Generate slides
   146→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   147→  
   148→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   149→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   150→  
   151→  // Generate category slides
   152→  for (const [index, category] of finalCategories.entries()) {
   153→    const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   154→    if (photosWithImages.length > 0) {
   155→      await generateCategorySlides(pptx, category, index + 1, language);
   156→    }
   157→  }
   158→
   159→  // Collect all parts from all categories for the parts table
   160→  const allPhotos: PhotoData[] = [];
   161→  const allAdditionalParts: AdditionalPart[] = [];
   162→  finalCategories.forEach(category => {
   163→    allPhotos.push(...category.photos);
   164→    allAdditionalParts.push(...category.additionalParts);
   165→  });
   166→  
   167→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, allPhotos, allAdditionalParts, language);
   168→  
   169→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   170→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   171→  }
   172→  
   173→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   174→  
   175→  // Save the file
   176→  const fileName = `Relatorio_Home_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   177→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   178→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   179→}

   181→// Helper function to get translated category title and description
   182→function getCategoryTranslation(categoryId: string, language: Language): { title: string; description: string } {
   183→  const titleKey = `category.${categoryId}`;
   184→  const descKey = `category.${categoryId}Desc`;
   185→  
   186→  return {
   187→    title: t(titleKey, language, { defaultValue: categoryId }),
   188→    description: t(descKey, language, { defaultValue: '' }),
   189→  };
   190→}
   191→
   192→/**
   193→ * Detect photo orientation and return appropriate PPT dimensions.
   194→ */
   195→async function getPhotoDimensions(photo: PhotoData): Promise<{ w: number; h: number; isPortrait: boolean }> {
   196→  const imgData = photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData;
   197→  if (!imgData) return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   198→  try {
   199→    const info = await getImageInfo(imgData);
   200→    return info.isPortrait
   201→      ? { w: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W, h: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H, isPortrait: true }
   202→      : { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   203→  } catch {
   204→    return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   205→  }
   206→}
   207→
   208→/**
   209→ * Calculate x,y positions for 1 or 2 photos on a slide,
   210→ * centering them horizontally.
   211→ */
   212→function layoutPhotos(
   213→  dims1: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   214→  dims2: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   215→  y: number,
   216→  gap: number
   217→): Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> {
   218→  const result: Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> = [null, null];
   219→  
   220→  if (!dims1 && !dims2) return result;
   221→  
   222→  if (dims1 && !dims2) {
   223→    // Single photo: center it
   224→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims1.w) / 2, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   225→    return result;
   226→  }
   227→  
   228→  if (dims1 && dims2) {
   229→    // Two photos: center them together
   230→    const totalW = dims1.w + gap + dims2.w;
   231→    const startX = (10 - totalW) / 2;
   232→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: startX, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   233→    result[1] = { photo: null!, x: startX + dims1.w + gap, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   234→    return result;
   235→  }
   236→  
   237→  // Only dims2 (shouldn't happen)
   238→  result[1] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims2.w) / 2, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   239→  return result;
   240→}
   241→
   242→/**
   243→ * Get height based on image aspect ratio for a given width.
   244→ * Returns a default height if image data can't be parsed.
   245→ */
   246→async function getAspectRatioHeight(targetW: number, imgData: string): Promise<number> {
   247→  try {
   248→    const info = await getImageInfo(imgData);
   249→    const ratio = info.height / info.width;
   250→    const h = targetW * ratio;
   251→    // Clamp between 2.5 and 5.0 inches
   252→    return Math.max(2.5, Math.min(5.0, h));
   253→  } catch {
   254→    return PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H;
   255→  }
   256→}
   257→
   258→async function generateCategorySlides(
   259→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   260→  category: PhotoCategory, 
   261→  categoryNumber: number,
   262→  language: Language
   263→) {
   264→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   265→  const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   266→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   267→  
   268→  // Get translated title
   269→  const { title: translatedTitle } = getCategoryTranslation(category.id, language);
   270→  
   271→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   272→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   273→    addCategoryHeader(slide, `${categoryNumber}. ${translatedTitle.toUpperCase()}`);
   274→    
   275→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   276→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   277→    
   278→    const isDual1 = !!(photo1?.secondaryImageData && photo1?.imageData);
   279→    const isDual2 = !!(photo2?.secondaryImageData && photo2?.imageData);
   280→    
   281→    // Calculate widths: dual photos get wider slots
   282→    let w1: number, h1: number, w2: number, h2: number;
   283→    const y = 1.2;
   284→    const gap = 0.2;
   285→    const usableW = 10 - SLIDE_MARGIN * 2;
   286→    
   287→    if (isDual1 && isDual2) {
   288→      // Both dual: equal wide slots
   289→      w1 = (usableW - gap) / 2;
   290→      w2 = w1;
   291→      h1 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   292→      h2 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   293→    } else if (isDual1) {
   294→      // Photo 1 dual, photo 2 single
   295→      w1 = DUAL_SLOT_W;
   296→      w2 = usableW - w1 - gap;
   297→      h1 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   298→      h2 = photo2 ? (photo2.editedImageData || photo2.imageData ? getAspectRatioHeight(w2, photo2.editedImageData || photo2.imageData!) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H;
   299→    } else if (isDual2) {
   300→      // Photo 1 single, photo 2 dual
   301→      w2 = DUAL_SLOT_W;
   302→      w1 = usableW - w2 - gap;
   303→      h1 = photo1 ? (photo1.editedImageData || photo1.imageData ? getAspectRatioHeight(w1, photo1.editedImageData || photo1.imageData!) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H;
   304→      h2 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   305→    } else {
   306→      // Both single: use orientation detection
   307→      const dims1 = photo1 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo1) : null;
   308→      const dims2 = photo2 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo2) : null;
   309→      const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, y, gap);
   310→      
   311→      if (photo1?.imageData && positions[0]) {
   312→        await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, positions[0].x, positions[0].y, positions[0].w, positions[0].h, language, String(i * 2 + 1));
   313→      }
   314→      if (photo2?.imageData && positions[1]) {
   315→        await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language, String(i * 2 + 2));
   316→      }
   317→      addStandardFooter(slide);
   318→      continue;
   319→    }
   320→    
   321→    // Place photos with calculated widths
   322→    const x1 = SLIDE_MARGIN;
   323→    const x2 = x1 + w1 + gap;
   324→    
   325→    if (photo1?.imageData) {
   326→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, x1, y, w1, h1, language, String(i * 2 + 1));
   327→    }
   328→    if (photo2?.imageData) {
   329→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, x2, y, w2, h2, language, String(i * 2 + 2));
   330→    }
   331→    
   332→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   333→  }
   334→}

   511→async function generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx: pptxgen, inspection: InspectionData, language: Language) {
   512→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   513→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   514→  addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'MACHINE IDENTIFICATION' : 'IDENTIFICAÇÃO DA MÁQUINA');
   515→  
   516→  // Title
   517→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Machine Identification' : 'Identificação da Máquina', {
   518→    x: 0.3,
   519→    y: 1.1,
   520→    w: 9.4,
   521→    h: 0.4,
   522→    fontSize: 16,
   523→    bold: true,
   524→    color: '000000',
   525→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   526→    align: 'center',
   527→  });
   528→  
   529→  // Photo positions (4 columns) - centered on slide
   530→  const photoWidth = 2.1;
   531→  const photoHeight = 2.1;
   532→  const gap = 0.3;
   533→  const totalWidth = (photoWidth * 4) + (gap * 3);
   534→  const startX = (10 - totalWidth) / 2; // Center the photo group
   535→  const photoY = 1.7;
   536→  
   537→  // Photo 1: Equipamento
   538→  const photo1X = startX;
   539→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   540→    x: photo1X,
   541→    y: photoY,
   542→    w: photoWidth,
   543→    h: photoHeight,
   544→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   545→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },
   546→  });
   547→  
   548→  if (inspection.machinePhoto) {
   549→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(inspection.machinePhoto, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: photoHeight });
   550→    slide.addImage({
   551→      data: processed,
   552→      x: photo1X,
   553→      y: photoY,
   554→      w: photoWidth,
   555→      h: photoHeight,
   556→    });
   557→  } else {
   558→    // Placeholder with camera icon

   790→
   791→async function generatePhotoSlides(pptx: pptxgen, photos: PhotoData[], language: Language) {
   792→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   793→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   794→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   795→  
   796→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   797→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   798→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PHOTOS' : 'FOTOS');
   799→    
   800→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   801→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   802→    
   803→    const isDual1 = !!(photo1?.secondaryImageData && photo1?.imageData);
   804→    const isDual2 = !!(photo2?.secondaryImageData && photo2?.imageData);
   805→    
   806→    let w1: number, h1: number, w2: number, h2: number;
   807→    const y = 1.2;
   808→    const gap = 0.2;
   809→    const usableW = 10 - SLIDE_MARGIN * 2;
   810→    
   811→    if (isDual1 && isDual2) {
   812→      w1 = (usableW - gap) / 2;
   813→      w2 = w1;
   814→      h1 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   815→      h2 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   816→    } else if (isDual1) {
   817→      w1 = DUAL_SLOT_W;
   818→      w2 = usableW - w1 - gap;
   819→      h1 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   820→      h2 = photo2 ? (photo2.editedImageData || photo2.imageData ? getAspectRatioHeight(w2, photo2.editedImageData || photo2.imageData!) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H;
   821→    } else if (isDual2) {
   822→      w2 = DUAL_SLOT_W;
   823→      w1 = usableW - w2 - gap;
   824→      h1 = photo1 ? (photo1.editedImageData || photo1.imageData ? getAspectRatioHeight(w1, photo1.editedImageData || photo1.imageData!) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H) : PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H;
   825→      h2 = DUAL_PHOTO_H;
   826→    } else {
   827→      const dims1 = photo1 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo1) : null;
   828→      const dims2 = photo2 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo2) : null;
   829→      const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, y, gap);
   830→      
   831→      if (photo1?.imageData && positions[0]) {
   832→        await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, positions[0].x, positions[0].y, positions[0].w, positions[0].h, language, String(i * 2 + 1));
   833→      }
   834→      if (photo2?.imageData && positions[1]) {
   835→        await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language, String(i * 2 + 2));
   836→      }
   837→      addStandardFooter(slide);
   838→      continue;
   839→    }
   840→    
   841→    const x1 = SLIDE_MARGIN;
   842→    const x2 = x1 + w1 + gap;
   843→    
   844→    if (photo1?.imageData) {
   845→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, x1, y, w1, h1, language, String(i * 2 + 1));
   846→    }
   847→    if (photo2?.imageData) {
   848→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, x2, y, w2, h2, language, String(i * 2 + 2));
   849→    }
   850→    
   851→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   852→  }
   853→}
   854→
   855→async function addPhotoToSlide(
   856→  slide: pptxgen.Slide, 
   857→  photo: PhotoData, 
   858→  x: number, 
   859→  y: number, 
   860→  w: number, 
   861→  h: number,
   862→  language: Language,
   863→  photoRef: string
   864→) {
   865→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   866→  
   867→  // Check if we have a secondary photo (two photos side by side)
   868→  const hasSecondaryPhoto = photo.secondaryImageData && photo.imageData;
   869→  
   870→  // Calculate photo widths
   871→  const dualGap = 0.15;  // Gap between primary and secondary photo
   872→  const photoWidth = hasSecondaryPhoto ? (w - dualGap) / 2 : w;
   873→  
   874→  // Photo info overlay (if PN exists)
   875→  if (photo.pn) {
   876→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   877→      x: x,
   878→      y: y - 0.4,
   879→      w: w,
   880→      h: 0.35,
   881→      fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 70 },
   882→    });
   883→    
   884→    let infoText = `${isTranslated ? 'Part Number:' : 'Numero da Peça:'} ${photo.pn}`;
   885→    if (photo.partName) infoText += ` ${photo.partName}`;
   886→    if (photo.quantity) infoText += ` ${isTranslated ? 'Qty:' : 'Qtd:'} ${photo.quantity}`;
   887→    
   888→    slide.addText(infoText, {
   889→      x: x + 0.1,
   890→      y: y - 0.35,
   891→      w: w - 0.2,
   892→      h: 0.25,
   893→      fontSize: 9,
   894→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   895→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   896→    });
   897→  }
   898→  
   899→  // Primary Photo
   900→  if (photo.imageData) {
   901→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: h });
   902→    slide.addImage({
   903→      data: processed || '',
   904→      x: x,
   905→      y: y,
   906→      w: photoWidth,
   907→      h: h,
   908→    });
   909→  }
   910→  
   911→  // Secondary Photo (lado a lado)
   912→  if (photo.secondaryImageData) {
   913→    const secondX = hasSecondaryPhoto ? x + photoWidth + dualGap : x;
   914→    const secondW = hasSecondaryPhoto ? photoWidth : w;
   915→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.secondaryImageData, { targetW: secondW, targetH: h });
   916→    slide.addImage({
   917→      data: processed,
   918→      x: secondX,
   919→      y: y,
   920→      w: secondW,
   921→      h: h,
   922→    });
   923→  }
   924→  
   925→  // Photo reference badge
   926→  const refLabel = isTranslated ? `Photo ${photoRef}` : `Foto ${photoRef}`;
   927→  slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   928→    x: x + 0.08,
   929→    y: y + h - 0.38,
   930→    w: 0.7,
   931→    h: 0.3,
   932→    fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 40 },
   933→    rectRadius: 0.04,
   934→  });
   935→  slide.addText(refLabel, {
   936→    x: x + 0.08,
   937→    y: y + h - 0.38,
   938→    w: 0.7,
   939→    h: 0.3,
   940→    fontSize: 8,
   941→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   942→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   943→    bold: true,
   944→    align: 'center',
   945→    valign: 'middle',
   946→  });
   947→
   948→  // Description
   949→  if (photo.description) {
   950→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   951→      x: x,
   952→      y: y + h,
   953→      w: w,
   954→      h: 0.6,
   955→      fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   956→    });
   957→    
   958→    slide.addText(photo.description.substring(0, 150), {
   959→      x: x + 0.1,
   960→      y: y + h + 0.05,
   961→      w: w - 0.2,
   962→      h: 0.5,
   963→      fontSize: 8,
   964→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   965→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   966→    });
   967→  }
   968→}
   969→
   970→// Interface for hierarchical parts structure
   971→interface PartRow {
   972→  pn: string;
   973→  serialNumber: string;
   974→  partName: string;
   975→  quantity: string;
   976→  isSubPart: boolean;
   977→  parentPn?: string;
   978→  indent: number;
   979→  photoRef?: string;
   980→}
   981→
   982→function generatePartsTableSlides(
   983→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   984→  photos: PhotoData[], 
   985→  additionalParts: AdditionalPart[],
   986→  language: Language
   987→) {
   988→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   989→  // Build photo ref maps (same numbering as generatePhotoSlides)
   990→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   991→  const photoRefMap = new Map<string, string>();   // PN → photo number
   992→  const photoIdRefMap = new Map<string, string>();  // photo ID → photo number
   993→  photosWithImages.forEach((p, idx) => {
   994→    if (p.pn) photoRefMap.set(p.pn, String(idx + 1));
   995→    photoIdRefMap.set(p.id, String(idx + 1));
   996→  });
   997→
   998→  // Build hierarchical parts structure
   999→  const partRows: PartRow[] = [];
  1000→  
  1001→  // Process each photo that should be in the table (has PN or has sub-parts)
  1002→  photos
  1003→    .filter(p => photoShouldBeInPartsTable(p, additionalParts))
  1004→    .forEach(photo => {
  1005→      const displayPn = getDisplayPn(photo, additionalParts);
  1006→      const photoRef = photo.pn
  1007→        ? photoRefMap.get(photo.pn)
  1008→        : photoIdRefMap.get(photo.id);
  1009→      
  1010→      // Add main part
  1011→      partRows.push({
  1012→        pn: displayPn,
  1013→        serialNumber: photo.serialNumber || '',
  1014→        partName: photo.partName || '-',
  1015→        quantity: photo.quantity || '-',
  1016→        isSubPart: false,
  1017→        indent: 0,
  1018→        photoRef,
  1019→      });
  1020→      
  1021→      // Find and add all sub-parts for this photo
  1022→      const subParts = getSubPartsForPhoto(photo, additionalParts);
  1023→      subParts.forEach(subPart => {
  1024→        partRows.push({
  1025→          pn: subPart.pn,
  1026→          serialNumber: subPart.serialNumber || '',
  1027→          partName: subPart.partName,
  1028→          quantity: subPart.quantity,
  1029→          isSubPart: true,
  1030→          parentPn: displayPn,
  1031→          indent: 1,
  1032→          photoRef,
  1033→        });
  1034→      });
  1035→    });
  1036→  
  1037→  if (partRows.length === 0) return;
  1038→  
  1039→  // Calculate slides needed (8 rows per slide - peças principais + sub-peças)
  1040→  const rowsPerSlide = 8;
  1041→  const slidesNeeded = Math.ceil(partRows.length / rowsPerSlide);
  1042→  
  1043→  for (let slideIndex = 0; slideIndex < slidesNeeded; slideIndex++) {
  1044→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
  1045→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PARTS TABLE' : 'TABELA DE PEÇAS');
  1046→    
  1047→    // Table title with page indicator if multiple slides
  1048→    const titleText = slidesNeeded > 1 
  1049→      ? `${isTranslated ? 'Parts Table' : 'Tabela de Peças'} (${slideIndex + 1}/${slidesNeeded})`
  1050→      : (isTranslated ? 'Parts Table (Part Number)' : 'Tabela de Peças (Numero da Peça)');
  1051→    
  1052→    slide.addText(titleText, {
  1053→      x: 0.5,
  1054→      y: 1.2,
  1055→      w: 8,
  1056→      h: 0.4,
  1057→      fontSize: 14,
  1058→      bold: true,
  1059→      color: '000000',
  1060→      fontFace: 'Arial',
  1061→    });
  1062→    
  1063→    // Table header
  1064→    const headerY = 1.7;
  1065→    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
  1066→      x: 0.5,
  1067→      y: headerY,
  1068→      w: 9,
  1069→      h: 0.4,
  1070→      fill: { color: '000000' },
  1071→    });
  1072→    
  1073→    const headers = [
  1074→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Ref' : 'Ref', x: 0.5, w: 0.6 },
  1075→      { text: isTranslated ? 'PN (Serial)' : 'PN (Serial)', x: 1.1, w: 2.2 },
  1076→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Part Name' : 'Nome da Peça', x: 3.3, w: 2.6 },
  1077→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Qty' : 'Qtd', x: 5.9, w: 1 },
  1078→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Type' : 'Tipo', x: 6.9, w: 2.6 },
  1079→    ];
  1080→    
  1081→    headers.forEach(header => {
  1082→      slide.addText(header.text, {
  1083→        x: header.x,
  1084→        y: headerY + 0.05,
  1085→        w: header.w,
  1086→        h: 0.3,
  1087→        fontSize: 10,
  1088→        bold: true,
  1089→        color: 'FFFFFF',
  1090→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1091→        align: 'center',
  1092→      });
  1093→    });
  1094→    
  1095→    // Table rows
  1096→    const startIdx = slideIndex * rowsPerSlide;
  1097→    const endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + rowsPerSlide, partRows.length);
  1098→    const slideParts = partRows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);
  1099→    
  1100→    let rowY = headerY + 0.4;
  1101→    const rowHeight = 0.35;
  1102→    
  1103→    slideParts.forEach((part, idx) => {
  1104→      // Row background - different colors for main and sub-parts
  1105→      const bgColor = part.isSubPart ? 'FFF5E6' : (idx % 2 === 0 ? 'F8F9FA' : 'FFFFFF');
  1106→      slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
  1107→        x: 0.5,
  1108→        y: rowY,
  1109→        w: 9,
  1110→        h: rowHeight,
  1111→        fill: { color: bgColor },
  1112→        line: part.isSubPart ? { color: 'FFE0B2', width: 0.5 } : undefined,
  1113→      });
  1114→      
  1115→      // Ref column (Foto X)
  1116→      const refText = part.photoRef 
  1117→        ? (isTranslated ? `Photo ${part.photoRef}` : `Foto ${part.photoRef}`)
  1118→        : '-';
  1119→      slide.addText(refText, {
  1120→        x: 0.5,
  1121→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1122→        w: 0.6,
  1123→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1124→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1125→        color: part.photoRef ? 'FF6600' : '999999',
  1126→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1127→        align: 'center',
  1128→        valign: 'middle',
  1129→        bold: !!part.photoRef,
  1130→      });
  1131→
  1132→      // Sub-part indicator (arrow or dash)
  1133→      if (part.isSubPart) {
  1134→        slide.addText('└─', {
  1135→          x: 1.1,
  1136→          y: rowY + 0.05,
  1137→          w: 0.3,
  1138→          h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1139→          fontSize: 9,
  1140→          color: 'FF6600',
  1141→          fontFace: 'Arial',
  1142→          align: 'center',
  1143→          valign: 'middle',
  1144→        });
  1145→      }
  1146→      
  1147→      // Part Number with Serial (with indent for sub-parts)
  1148→      const pnX = part.isSubPart ? 1.35 : 1.1;
  1149→      const pnText = part.serialNumber 
  1150→        ? `${part.pn} (${part.serialNumber})`
  1151→        : part.pn;
  1152→      slide.addText(pnText, {
  1153→        x: pnX,
  1154→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1155→        w: part.isSubPart ? 1.95 : 2.2,
  1156→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1157→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1158→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'CC5200' : '000000',
  1159→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1160→        align: 'center',
  1161→        valign: 'middle',
  1162→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1163→      });
  1164→      
  1165→      // Part Name
  1166→      slide.addText(part.partName, {
  1167→        x: 3.3,
  1168→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1169→        w: 2.6,
  1170→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1171→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1172→        color: part.isSubPart ? '666666' : '000000',
  1173→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1174→        align: 'center',
  1175→        valign: 'middle',
  1176→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1177→      });
  1178→      
  1179→      // Quantity
  1180→      slide.addText(part.quantity, {
  1181→        x: 5.9,
  1182→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1183→        w: 1,
  1184→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1185→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1186→        color: '000000',
  1187→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1188→        align: 'center',
  1189→        valign: 'middle',
  1190→      });
  1191→      
  1192→      // Type column
  1193→      const typeText = part.isSubPart 
  1194→        ? (isTranslated ? '↳ Sub-part' : '↳ Sub-peça')
  1195→        : (isTranslated ? 'Main' : 'Principal');
  1196→      
  1197→      slide.addText(typeText, {
  1198→        x: 6.9,
  1199→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1200→        w: 2.6,
  1201→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1202→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1203→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'FF6600' : '000000',
  1204→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1205→        align: 'center',
  1206→        valign: 'middle',
  1207→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1208→      });
  1209→      
  1210→      rowY += rowHeight;
  1211→    });
  1212→    
  1213→    addStandardFooter(slide);
  1214→  }
  1215→}

  1217→function generateConclusionSlide(pptx: pptxgen, conclusion: string, language: Language) {
  1218→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
  1219→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
  1220→  addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'CONCLUSION' : 'CONCLUSÃO');

  1429→function formatDateForFileName(dateString: string): string {
  1430→  if (!dateString) return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  1431→  
  1432→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues
  1433→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1434→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1435→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1436→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1437→    const year = parts[0];
  1438→    return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1439→  }
  1440→  
  1441→  // Fallback: use current date
  1442→  const today = new Date();
  1443→  const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  1444→  const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  1445→  const year = today.getFullYear();
  1446→  return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1447→}
  1448→
  1449→function formatDateForDisplay(dateString: string): string {
  1450→  if (!dateString) return '';
  1451→  
  1452→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues (YYYY-MM-DD format)
  1453→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1454→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1455→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1456→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1457→    const year = parts[0];
  1458→    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  1459→  }
  1460→  
  1461→  return dateString;
  1462→}
